name: Dr Ali Schnabel
title: Clinical Psychologist
description: Clinical psychologist in Thornbury offering adult psychotherapy using psychodynamic psychotherapy and Internal Family Systems (IFS). Works at a Centre Against Sexual Assault providing therapy to victim/survivors of sexual violence. Helps with childhood trauma, healing from sexual violence, psychosis, adult autism, and 'Issues relating to relationships, sexuality, identity and sense of self'. Assessment expertise in autism, complex trauma and dissociation. Waitlist currently closed for therapy.
specialties: complex trauma, dissociation, sexual violence, childhood trauma, IFS, psychodynamic, adult autism, psychosis, sexuality

name: Rae Sabine
title: Certified Supervisor, Creative/Experiential Therapist and Counsellor
description: Creative/experiential therapist passionate about disability rights, LGBTQIA+ communities and mental health. Facilitates creative workshops in Switchboard's LGBTQIA+ Suicide Bereavement Program and has run Arts Psychotherapy workshops for trans and non-binary folk. Member of AusPATH and TPATH; specialised training in ethical WPATH letter writing, supporting people navigating gender-affirming healthcare. Trained in ACT, IFS, DBT. Offers supervision on Diversity in Gender, Body, Kinship & Sexuality.
specialties: trans, non-binary, gender diverse, WPATH letters, LGBTQIA+, arts therapy, IFS, neurodivergent, disability, NDIS
identity: 'I'm a trans non-binary, multiple neurodivergent, dynamically disabled and chronically ill Certified Supervisor, Creative/Experiential Therapist and Counsellor. I have white Anglophone privilege and settler privilege.'

name: Samuel Hardidge
title: Arts Psychotherapist
description: Non-binary/genderfluid Arts Psychotherapist offering trauma informed practice, parts work, and an 'LGBTQIA+ and Diversity safe space'. Has provided creative arts and arts therapy programs for people with a disability, LGBTQIA+, indigenous people, and people experiencing mental illness.
specialties: arts therapy, trauma informed, parts work, LGBTQIA+, disability

name: Avanthi Chrystine
title: Peer Counsellor
description: Peer counsellor on Wurundjeri Woi Wurrung Country with a particular passion for working with people in the LGBTQIA+ and neurodiverse communities. Draws from strengths-based, narrative therapy and DBT. Lived and living experience includes LGBTQIA+ issues (gender and sexuality explorations, ace-spectrum, body dysphoria), ADHD, chronic pain, person of colour. Telehealth. Not currently taking new people (waitlist).
specialties: peer counselling, LGBTQIA+, gender and sexuality exploration, ace-spectrum, neurodivergent, person of colour
identity: Lived and living experience with 'LGBTQIA+ issues', 'Person of Colour', ADHD

name: Thalia Koulas
title: Founder and Peer Counsellor
description: Works primarily with LGBTQIA+ and neurodivergent people, especially those navigating autism, ADHD, gender diversity, sexual diversity, and complex trauma; particularly passionate about neurodivergent trans and gender-diverse people and people who are bi, pan or asexual. Uses Liberation Psychology, Internal Family Systems (IFS), CFT and Existential Therapy. Lived experience includes sex work and trauma. Not suitable for anyone seeking CBT. Waitlist.
specialties: trans and gender diverse, complex trauma, IFS, LGBTQIA+, bi/pan/asexual, sex work, autism, ADHD, peer counselling
identity: 'a queer AuDHDer'; lived experience: 'agender, queer and bi+'; 'Intergenerational trauma in a CALD (Greek) family'

name: Claire Munns
title: Lived Experience Practitioner
description: Supports people aged 16 to 45, 'with a strong focus on the Autistic, neurodivergent, non-binary, and queer communities' — those labelled 'too complex' by other services. Lived and living experience includes LGBTQIA+ issues (gender, sexuality), autism (AFAB adult journey), BPD, chronic pain. Telehealth. Not currently taking new people.
specialties: non-binary, queer, autistic, neurodivergent, BPD, peer support
identity: Lived and living experience with 'LGBTQIA+ issues - gender, sexuality', autism (AFAB), ADHD, BPD
